evidence: The dielectric constants of the ALD films were calculated to be similar to pure Al2O3 ALD, being ∼7. The Al2O3 ALD films are insulating, amorphous, and smooth. The density of Al2O3 ALD deposited at 177 ◦C has a density of ∼3.0 g/cm3. Atomic force microscope (AFM) images revealed an average surface roughness of 0.27 nm that was independent of deposition temperature and film composition.
